notes:
Summary: SignalForge is a mid-to-large contact center SaaS vendor that wants to add automated post-call briefings, QA scoring, and coachable highlights into their existing supervisor dashboard. They ingest 50k calls/month today; peak spikes up to 1.2k concurrent calls during promos. Primary ask: high-throughput post-call summarization + structured QA outputs, plus optional near-real-time agent assist snippets during wrap-up.

Key technical constraints and quotes:
- "We can tolerate up to 60s turnaround for full post-call summaries, but QA scoring must surface within 10s to flag potential escalations."
- PII: many calls include payment info — must support masking and customer-managed KMS for transcript encryption.
- Routing/fallback: need automatic model fallback to a cheaper quantized variant during burst hours, with graceful degradation of summary length/quality.
- Integration: tool-calling required to automatically create tickets in their JIRA-like system and push summary + tags to their CRM via API.

POC scope (proposed):
- Run 2-week POC on Dedicated pool (GPU T4/Xeon equivalent) processing 5k historical calls and 100 live post-call jobs/day.
- Deliverables: latency/cost report, QA accuracy vs current human baselines, primer on batching/kv-cache savings, example webhook for ticket creation.

Sales/Procurement notes:
- Buying center: Head of CX (primary), VP Eng, Infosec. Security asks slowing diligence — legal wants SOC2 Type II report and KMS attestation.
- Commercial sticker: leaning toward 12–24 month reserved capacity if POC meets throughput and quality targets.

Tech follow-ups required:
- Provide SAML test metadata and demo SSO login (Aisha to coordinate).
- Provide on-prem installer checklist and hardened network diagram for infosec review.
- Draft SOW + pricing for 12mo dedicated commit and optional private deployment.

Links: security deck + transcript samples available in Drive. Fireflies IDs for call recordings attached. Jira escalations captured (see INF-7421).
